returned_textual_content: # Questions, comments, discussions, etc. You can create a simple discussion thread that has no impact on the model content, tagged as a q*uestion*, d*iscussion*, or i*ssue*. These consist of a series of comments from whomever wishes to join in. Only two discussion thread statuses are possible: o*pen* and c*losed*. If a thread is open, anyone can add a comment; if it is closed, If you click on the `New discussion` button on the Activities tab, a new thread is created, tagged with d*iscussion*. If you click on the drop-down next to the button, you can create a thread that is tagged as a q*uestion*, d*iscussion*, or i*ssue*. Tags can be changed at any time by any user with at least Viewer access to the model. For example, here is a simple discussion about a model that could be imported - any user who has access to the Model can contribute. A comment can be edited by the author of the comment. In this simple Activity the possible actions are limited to editing tags, adding a comment, and closing the discussion. If required, it could be reopened at a future date if a user has more to say. ## List Discussions, etc. The **Activities** tab on the [Model Overview](/the-user-interface/models-ui/model-overview) provides access to a list of activities for a model, select the **Basic** type of activity in the filter dropdown if you want to show only discussions. ## Close a Discussion, etc. A discussion can be closed at any time, using the Activity page - click on the `Close activity` button at the foot of the screen. The discussion can be reopened at any time by any user with access to the model.
